prompt: Overhead documentary photograph of printed proof sheets fanned out on a backlit light table in a bright, quiet print room. The sheets are on coloured paper stocks (pale cyan, warm yellow, soft magenta, white) and are printed only with calm flat colour blocks, ruled boxes and fine halftone fields in cyan, magenta and yellow, no photographs; hairline crop marks sit in the margins and a printer's colour control bar of small solid cyan, magenta, yellow and black squares runs along one sheet edge. One sheet is lifted at a corner and reveals a precise grid of ruled empty boxes underneath. A single small vermilion registration mark (circle with crosshair). Large calm areas of paper, soft cool daylight, shallow depth of field, editorial. Absolutely no legible text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no trademarks.
